facts.fact: 第二场配置：给她配最强狼队友、留两支箭
facts.anchor: He’d paired her with one of the strongest wolves in hopes of giving her a fighting chance

facts.fact: 威胁 Micah：再提她就撕你肋骨
facts.anchor: If you mention Red Riding Hood again, I’ll tear your rib cage out of your chest

facts.fact: 发现 Micah 消失——弃赛冲进围场
坑边嘲讽：队友睡倒没法合作
facts.anchor: It’s rather hard to work as a team when one of you is asleep.

facts.fact: 帮助条件：出坑后靠自己
facts.anchor: I will help you out of the trap. However, you’ll still have to survive on your own after.

facts.fact: 拉她出坑双双摔倒胸贴脸贴
facts.anchor: Her chest landed on his, their faces only an inch apart, and every curve of their bodies molded together

facts.fact: Micah 袭 Winter，Sterling 一箭射肩——Winter 亲手扭断 Micah 脖子
facts.anchor: He took Micah’s head between his hands and snapped his neck

facts.fact: 童识至今无悔意；内心声音 Hypocrite
facts.anchor: Despite having known him since childhood, Winter felt no remorse when the body crumpled to the ground.

facts.fact: 她宣称两清：我救了你的命
facts.anchor: “I saved your life,” Sterling said. “We’re even now.”

facts.fact: Amalli 报捷：RRH 与队友赢；国王在等
facts.anchor: I thought you’d like to know Red Riding Hood and her teammate won the game

facts.fact: 国王命令：明晚交配仪式带人类参加——人类从未参加过
facts.anchor: Tomorrow night we’re hosting a mating ceremony for two of my wolves. You’ll attend with the human so I will formally meet the infamous Red Riding Hood.
